events.name: Bash
events.head: Check fix ancestry and rate-limit code
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git log -1 --format='%h %ci' origin/main && git merge-base --is-ancestor a67da2c origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; git show --stat --format='%h %s' a67da2c | head -8; grep -n "rate\|limit\|429\|tries" cloud/src/webinar.ts | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read rate-limit block and list deployments
events.input: $ sed -n 40,62p cloud/src/webinar.ts; git diff --stat origin/main -- cloud/src/webinar.ts app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Created|Version" | tail -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Production checks: page, hourly limit, placeholder, foreign origin

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check timing and page content
events.input:
$ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log -1 --format=%ci 73f5116e; date; curl -s "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/webinar/register?v=20261012v" | grep -oE '

[^<]*

|class="when">[^<]*'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read test signup row from production D1
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && npx wrangler d1 execute $(grep -m1 -oE 'database_name *= *"[^"]+"' wrangler.toml | cut -d'"' -f2) --remote --json --command "SELECT email,status,tries,test,tantra,updated_at FROM webinar_signups WHERE email='[email]'" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"(tries|status|test|tantra|updated_at)"'

events.text: Next I'm reading the test sign-up row from production D1 to confirm no new Zoom call was made.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read test signup row from production D1
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && ls wrangler.* ; DB=$(grep -m1 -oE '"database_name" *: *"[^"]+"' wrangler.json* | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"//'); echo DB=$DB; npx wrangler d1 execute "$DB" --remote --json --command "SELECT status,tries,test,tantra,updated_at FROM webinar_signups WHERE email='[email]'" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"(tries|status|test|tantra|updated_at)"'

events.text: Production checks out. Now running the probe on a clean worktree of origin/main against vendor-sim.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe usage header
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs | grep -iE "usage|run|port|sim|BASE|env" | head -12; ls scripts/vendor-sim* app/scripts/vendor-sim* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find stack setup instructions and simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && sed -n 1,12p app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs | head -8; git ls-files | grep -i "vendor-sim" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read simulator usage and dev var names
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && sed -n 1,30p scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -iE "usage|port|wrangler|var|BASE" | head -12; grep -oE '^[A-Z_]*(BASE|URL|API)[A-Z_]*' .dev.vars | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how centre points at simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -rn "vendor-sim" app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -n "ZOOM.*BASE\|_BASE\b\|SIM" cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head -5

events.text: Setting up a private stack (sim on 8897, centre on 8896) in a clean worktree at origin/main to run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private sim and centre from clean worktree
events.input: $ set -e; R=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; W=/tmp/t237-verify; rm -rf $W; git -C $R worktree add -q --detach $W origin/main; cp $R/cloud/.dev.vars $W/cloud/.dev.vars; ln -s $R/cloud/node_modules $W/cloud/node_modules
